newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Soymeal in Europe follows higher Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Soymeal in Europe follows higher Chicago.

text.p: Sellers on the European meals and feeds market offered South American soymeal pellets around $4 up from yesterday, following last night's stronger Chicago soymeal futures close, market sources saiad.
Most other products were quoted at slightly easier levels due to a lack of demand against abundant supply.
"The higher seller prices and a steadier CBOT project A failed to attract much serious buying interest this morning" one broker said.
Only one trade was reported at $263 a tonne cif Rotterdam for afloat Argentine soymeal pellets.
